# Thorkel Ketilsson (C_THORKEL), drowned; lying dead and carried in play, found in Chapter 1's searches (Stage 10; Book 5 section 02), on the
# 32 x 48 canvas with their own layers: drawn by Claude, proposed, flagged for the user's review
# (decision DD-11). Generated by assets/art/authoring/people48.py; edit that script, not this map.
# Cloak layer: lags a frame behind the body and settles after it; streams in a gust.
sheet: layer_cloak_wool_thorkel
kind: sprite
palette: book07
size: 32x48
pivot: 16,47
footprint: 10x4
facings: s n e w
placeholder: false
anim.idle: frames 4, ticks 15, loop
anim.walk: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
anim.run: frames 8, ticks 3, loop
anim.dead: frames 1, ticks 60
anim.carried: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
event.footstep: walk 0, walk 3, run 0, run 4
pose.gather: seated
pose.kneel: seated
pose.sleep: lying
pose.dead: lying
pose.carried: carried
# The outline and the three tones are authored in the map (people48.py), aware of the
# layers below this one, so the generator adds no outline of its own.
outline: . 4
mark.A: stone 4
mark.B: stone 9
mark.C: stone 8
mark.D: stone 3
mark.E: stone 2
mark.F: stone 1
